source.method: Figma MCP get_design_context + read-only Plugin API geometry, slot bindings, instance sources and recursive variable aliases

description:
Filter chip — 목록·검색 결과를 조건으로 거르는 토글형 칩.
• selected: 필터 적용 여부(토글)
• state: enabled / hovered / pressed / focused(키보드 포커스 링) / disabled
• size: sm 28 · md 32(기본) · lg 36
• leading icon: 카테고리·아이콘 필터
• count: 적용 항목 수 배지(멀티 선택 드롭다운 등)
• trailing icon: chevron-down = 드롭다운 필터 / x = 제거형(적용 필터 해제)
참고: Material 3 Filter chip, Carbon Tag, Atlassian, Polaris Filters

observations.note: Description mentions focused and md default; actual definitions contain only enabled/hovered/pressed/disabled and default size sm. Focus styling remains an implementation accessibility duty.

Leading/trailing icons and count are false by default in all24 variants. Count label visible=true is under hidden count parent. Hidden positions/colors describe stored source slots, not enabled-slot rendered layouts.

strokesIncludedInLayout=true: unselected/disabled have border1 inside and widths47/51/55, while selected non-disabled has no stroke and widths45/49/53. These content-based samples change by2px; do not silently claim stable geometry.
Interactive filter semantics extend the common informational Chip. Size/palette changes do not add selection behavior to AgentHubAgentTypeChip or common Chip.
